context: Evaluates implementation of a Vercel feature-flagged mobile insurance picker in the browse feed, including flag infrastructure, client-side resolution for ISR preservation, in-feed InsurancePicker component, FilterTopbar integration, session storage persistence, and Segment analytics.

checklist.name: insurance_picker_renders_in_feed
checklist.example: BrowseView renders a div with class 'lg:hidden' containing InsurancePicker below the FilterTopbar div when insuranceInfeedUxEnabled is true.
checklist.description: When the flag is enabled, a mobile-visible insurance picker UI component appears in the browse feed below the filter bar, hidden on large screens (lg breakpoint and above).

checklist.name: picker_toggle_applies_removes_filter
checklist.example: onToggle in BrowseView calls onSearchChange with updated refinementList that includes or omits accepted_insurance based on the enabled state.
checklist.description: Toggling the insurance picker on applies the saved insurance as a search refinement; toggling it off removes the insurance refinement from search results.

checklist.name: picker_open_triggers_insurance_selector
checklist.example: insuranceOpenRef wired between BrowseView and FilterTopbar; InsurancePicker onOpen calls insuranceOpenRef.current().
checklist.description: Tapping the picker when no insurance is selected (or tapping the insurance name) opens the existing insurance filter selector in the FilterTopbar.

checklist.name: insurance_chip_hidden_mobile_when_flag_enabled
checklist.example: FilterTopbar applies 'absolute max-h-0 max-w-0 overflow-hidden lg:relative lg:max-h-none lg:max-w-none lg:overflow-visible' to the insurance chip div when insuranceOpenRef is provided.
checklist.description: When the in-feed picker is active, the insurance chip in the FilterTopbar is visually hidden on mobile viewports to avoid duplication.

checklist.name: picker_only_on_location_taxonomy_page_types
checklist.example: insuranceInfeedUxEnabled checks isLocationPageType(pageType) || isTaxonomyPageType(pageType) in addition to the flag value.
checklist.description: The in-feed insurance picker is only shown on location and taxonomy page types, not on all browse pages.

checklist.name: session_storage_persists_insurance_selection
checklist.example: BrowseView saves activeInsurance to sessionStorage on toggle-off and reads from it via getSessionStorage when building savedInsurance; SAVED_INSURANCE_SESSION_KEY constant used.
checklist.description: When the user disables the insurance filter, the previously selected insurance is saved and restored when re-enabling, so users do not need to re-select their insurance on toggle.

checklist.name: flag_resolved_client_side_for_static_pages
checklist.example: browse/page.tsx and location/[slug]/page.tsx pass resolveInsuranceFilterInfeedOnClient without calling the flag directly; BrowseView fetches from /api/flags/insurance-filter-infeed/ via useInsuranceFilterInfeedFlagValue.
checklist.description: Pages that use ISR/static rendering evaluate the feature flag on the client (via a fetch to a Route Handler) rather than during server rendering, so the pages remain statically renderable.

checklist.name: uses_vercel_flags_sdk_pattern
checklist.example: insuranceFilterInfeedFlag defined via flag() from 'flags/next' with createVercelAdapter/vercelAdapter in services/flags/insuranceFilterInfeed/client.ts; key constant in const.ts.
checklist.description: The feature flag is defined using the Vercel Flags SDK (flags/next) with a Vercel adapter, following the existing services/flags directory structure with separate client.ts and const.ts modules.

checklist.name: uses_segment_cookies_for_flag_identity
checklist.example: identifyInsuranceFlagEntities reads ajs_user_id and ajs_anonymous_id cookies, URL-decodes and JSON-unwraps them, and returns { user: { id } }.
checklist.description: Flag user identification reads from the existing Segment analytics cookies (ajs_user_id / ajs_anonymous_id) to align flag targeting with Segment/Amplitude user identity.

checklist.name: uses_route_handler_pattern
checklist.example: GET handler in api/flags/insurance-filter-infeed/route.ts uses routeHandler({ protected: false, handler }) and returns successResponse({ enabled }).
checklist.description: The flag API endpoint uses the project's routeHandler wrapper and successResponse helper, consistent with other API routes in the codebase.

checklist.name: uses_segment_analytics_for_events
checklist.example: useSegment() used for analytics.ui.click events; useInsurancePickerInViewportSegment uses analytics.track with getCommonProperties(); trackFeatureFlag uses analytics.identify and analytics.track.
checklist.description: Analytics events (picker viewed, opened, toggled, filter applied) use the existing Segment analytics client and useSegment hook following the codebase's analytics patterns.

checklist.name: flag_discovery_endpoint_registered
checklist.description: The new flag is registered in the Vercel Flags discovery endpoint so it appears in the Flags Explorer / Vercel dashboard.

checklist.name: flags_env_vars_in_server_env
checklist.example: FLAGS and FLAGS_SECRET added as optional strings to serverSchema in src/lib/env.server.ts.
checklist.description: The FLAGS and FLAGS_SECRET environment variables needed by the Vercel Flags SDK are declared in the server env schema.

checklist.name: flag_exposure_tracked_once_per_session
checklist.example: hasTrackedFlagRef guards trackFeatureFlag call in BrowseView useEffect, ensuring it fires only when effectiveInsuranceFilterInfeed becomes true for the first time.
checklist.description: Feature flag exposure is tracked via Segment exactly once per component mount, not on every render, to avoid duplicate analytics events.

checklist.name: picker_viewed_fires_once_on_intersection
checklist.example: useInsurancePickerInViewportSegment uses IntersectionObserver and calls obs.unobserve(entry.target) after the first intersection event.
checklist.description: The 'insurance_filter_viewed' analytics event fires exactly once when the picker enters the viewport, not repeatedly on subsequent intersections or re-renders.

checklist.name: saved_insurance_cleared_on_explicit_remove
checklist.example: FilterTopbar clearFilters callback calls setSessionStorage(SAVED_INSURANCE_SESSION_KEY, []) when taxonomy === 'accepted_insurance'.
checklist.description: When the user explicitly removes the insurance filter via the FilterTopbar chip's clear action, the saved insurance in sessionStorage is also cleared.

checklist.name: picker_open_action_handles_uninitialized_ref
checklist.example: insuranceOpenRef.current?.() uses optional chaining; onOpenRef effect in LazyMultiSelectChip assigns handleOpen to the ref after mount.
checklist.description: The mechanism for opening the insurance filter from the InsurancePicker does not throw when the FilterTopbar's internal open handler has not yet been registered.

checklist.name: no_picker_when_flag_disabled
checklist.example: insuranceInfeedUxEnabled is false by default; all conditional rendering and insuranceOpenRef passing are gated on it.
checklist.description: When the feature flag is disabled or not yet resolved, the browse experience is unchanged — no InsurancePicker, no insurance chip hiding, no ref wiring.
